text:
amanda: Quick sync — proposed Q3 plan for Optimize toolkit. Focus areas: 1) eval-triggered alerts (prod guardrails) 2) quantization recommendation engine 3) dynamic batching hints + autosuggest 4) prefix/KV caching visibility + TTL recommendations. Looking for launch criteria and minimal scope we can ship in 8 weeks.

raj: +1. Can we scope eval alerts to regression detection first (BLEU/EMB drift + latency spikes) and postpone auto-remediation? Alerts should fire on evaluation signals not raw traffic.

nate: Agree. Need clear noise controls. Suggest: default alert if model-level drift > 5% across core prompts or latency p95 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive runs. Keep thresholds configurable.

olivia: From support/customer asks: customers want recommendations tied to cost impact estimates. e.g., "quantize to int8 -> ~30% cost reduction, 2% quality delta". We need the estimator in MVP.

amanda: Good. For MVP let's set: - eval alerts (regression detection + manual ack) - quant recs w/ cost-quality delta estimates - batching autosuggest (non-invasive UI hints) - basic cache visibility (hit rate + suggested TTLs). No automated rollouts.

raj: Tech notes: we can prototype quant recs by running evals on quantized checkpoints offline and diffing metrics. Batching autosuggest can use sampling of sequence length distribution; trivial heuristic: target batch size = argmax throughput under 99th p99 latency constraint.

nate: Example config snippet for autosuggest scoring:
```
batch_sugg: {
  metric: "throughput_per_cost",
  latency_slo_ms: 200,
  percentile: 99
}
```

olivia: Need launch criteria that product can use to close: 1) Customer beta with 2 customers, 2) Errors < 0.5% introduced by quant recs across eval sets, 3) Alerts produce actionable tickets in > 30% of cases.

amanda: Draft launch checklist: - Feature flag + audit logs - Eval pipeline integration - UI: recommendations + alert inbox - Docs + runbook - Beta cohort + feedback loop

raj: Dependencies: eval infra run parity, dataset of core prompts per-customer (PII notes), storage for samples. ETA: prototype in 3 weeks, beta in 8.

product-bot: Note: added `optimize-toolkit/q3` label and created GH issue #452 for quant recs

amanda: Next steps: I'll update PRD with MVP scope and target beta cohort; @olivia please pull 2 pilot customers. @raj please confirm infra tasks and I'll book weekly check-ins. Thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
